Implements AG Grid core services, APIs, and a React table view.

# Purpose
AG Grid core runtime code defines the services, controllers, and UI components that manage columns, filters, row rendering, editing, selection, focus, scrolling, overlays, and export behavior. It includes internal bean classes and helper functions that keep grid state in sync with user input and with changes to column state, row data, and layout modes such as pinned areas, print mode, auto-height, and sticky rows. The code also exposes public and semi-public API methods such as `getFilterInstance`, `setFilterModel`, `showColumnFilter`, `startEditingCell`, `stopEditing`, `getColumnState`, `refreshCells`, `paginationGoToPage`, `getDataAsCsv`, and `exportDataAsCsv`, which other grid parts use to control grid behavior. In addition, it registers reusable components such as cell editors, filter panels, header elements, overlays, and drag helpers, and it includes a React view that maps validator data into rows and renders an AG Grid table with columns such as `pubkey`, `name`, `description`, `stake`, `delinquent`, `lastVote`, and `rootSlot`.
